about: Test cases for the customer field rules, run against both copies of them: rules.test.ts runs them against customers/rules.ts, and .github/scripts/rule-cases.mjs posts them to POST /api/customers (CustomerValidation.cs). If the two copies disagree on any case, one of them fails.

Each case is the defaults with its input on top. A case has either errors (every field with a problem, to its exact message) or stored (what the API saves and sends back: trimmed, an empty optional field as null). Fields a case's stored leaves out are expected as the defaults store them.
A value is a string, or a list of parts joined together, where a part can be {"repeat": text, "count": n} for long values.
